## Paper

Changing the Boston School Choice Mechanism

## World

labor_market

## Institution

Deferred acceptance as applied market-design replacement.

## Agent type

Students/workers reporting preferences in a matching market.

## Theoretical benchmark

Mechanism changes can reduce manipulation and improve stability relative to manipulable assignment rules.

## Learning setup

Reported preferences feed a matching mechanism; learned reports are compared to truthful/stable benchmarks.

## Metrics

Truthfulness, stability, welfare, manipulation gain, blocking pairs.

## Main result

The paper presents evidence of strategic behavior among parents in the Boston school choice mechanism and advocates for replacing it with a strategy-proof deferred acceptance mechanism. It shows that some students could have been assigned to their stated choices with a different strategy under the current mechanism.

## What they prove

The deferred acceptance mechanism is strategy-proof and eliminates justified envy, while the Boston mechanism is vulnerable to strategic manipulation.

## What they only simulate

Empirical evidence of strategic behavior and its consequences in the Boston mechanism.

## What they do NOT test

The long-term welfare impacts of the new mechanism and its robustness to different types of strategic behavior.

## What we need to reproduce

Use fixed benchmark cases to separate mechanism manipulation from noisy learned reports.

## How our project differs

The paper is an applied school-choice reform. This repo abstracts the market to labor-style workers/employers and learning reports.

## Implementation obligations

Canonical preference cases; stable and unstable hand cases; welfare accounting; side-specific strategy-proofness checks.

## Metrics to compare in our repo

Labor Market fixed benchmark cases and full-run truthfulness/stability.

## Failure modes to audit

Random preference variation mistaken for mechanism effect; no fixed cases; no welfare accounting under alternate mechanisms.

## Project code comparison

Compare Changing the Boston School Choice Mechanism to run_labor_market_benchmark_cases.py outputs. The repo has the right fixed-case discipline but should not claim a school-choice reproduction.
